memory.method: 20 ms sampling of this benchmark Python process and descendants during consumption; summed RSS can double-count shared pages

environment.python: 3.13.11 | packaged by Anaconda, Inc. | (main, Dec 10 2025, 21:21:58) [MSC v.1929 64 bit (AMD64)]

method.admission: All originals uploaded, then 20 empty-field tickets admitted serially before consumer starts
method.timing: perf_counter_ns in Store post-commit notifications; one callback's final cursor covers every change in that transaction; observer overhead included
method.queueWait: Initial queued commit to first durable claim; includes remaining batch admission, reconciliation, Redis delivery and SQL claim, not pure Redis queue latency
method.ocr: Production spawn per attempt, including process startup, model verification/load, inference and child cleanup; not warm inference time
method.percentiles: Empirical median p50 and nearest-rank ceil(0.95*n) p95; single local run, no confidence or capacity claim
method.fixtures: In-process authenticated ASGI HTTP, fakeredis Streams, S3ObjectStore with in-memory FakeS3Client, local generated poster with fixture metadata
method.limits: No network/TLS, real Cognito, S3, Redis server, Commons retrieval, upload-network time, physical devices or EC2 capacity measured
